```{r}
# import libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
# import files
base <- "~/work/khat_gwas/phenotype_files/"

files <- c(
  AAU    = paste0(base, "AAU_khat_pheno.txt"),
  Uganda = paste0(base, "Uganda_khat_pheno.txt"),
  UCT    = paste0(base, "UCT_khat_pheno.txt"),
  KEMRI  = paste0(base, "KEMRI_khat_pheno.txt"),
  Moi    = paste0(base, "Moi_khat_pheno.txt")
)

df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  files,
  ~ readr::read_table(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Site = .y)
)
```

```{r}
# Variables and their valid phenotype values
phenotype_values <- list(
  assist_khat     = 0:1,
  assist_khat_amt = 0:5
)

for (site_name in names(files)) {
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Site:", site_name, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  site_df <- df %>%
    filter(Site == site_name)
  

  # KU: assist_khat

  
  ku_counts <- table(
    factor(
      site_df$assist_khat,
      levels = phenotype_values$assist_khat
    )
  )
  
  ku_count_0 <- as.integer(ku_counts["0"])
  ku_count_1 <- as.integer(ku_counts["1"])
  ku_overall <- ku_count_0 + ku_count_1
  
  ku_pct_cases <- if (ku_overall > 0) {
    100 * ku_count_1 / ku_overall
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  
  cat("\nKhat Use (assist_khat)\n")
  cat("Count 0:", ku_count_0, "\n")
  cat("Count 1:", ku_count_1, "\n")
  cat("Overall:", ku_overall, "\n")
  cat(
    "Percentage cases:",
    sprintf("%.2f%%", ku_pct_cases),
    "\n"
  )
  

  # KUF: assist_khat_amt

  
  kuf_counts <- table(
    factor(
      site_df$assist_khat_amt,
      levels = phenotype_values$assist_khat_amt
    )
  )
  
  kuf_overall <- sum(kuf_counts)
  
  cat("\nKhat Use Frequency (assist_khat_amt)\n")
  
  for (value in phenotype_values$assist_khat_amt) {
    cat(
      paste0("Count ", value, ":"),
      as.integer(kuf_counts[as.character(value)]),
      "\n"
    )
  }
  
  cat("Overall:", kuf_overall, "\n")
}
```
```{r}
# Overall KU counts and proportions across all sites
ku_control_count <- sum(df$assist_khat == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
ku_case_count    <- sum(df$assist_khat == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
ku_overall_count <- ku_control_count + ku_case_count

ku_summary <- data.frame(
  Phenotype = c("Controls (0)", "Cases (1)", "Overall"),
  Count = c(
    ku_control_count,
    ku_case_count,
    ku_overall_count
  ),
  Proportion = c(
    ku_control_count / ku_overall_count,
    ku_case_count / ku_overall_count,
    1
  ),
  Percentage = c(
    100 * ku_control_count / ku_overall_count,
    100 * ku_case_count / ku_overall_count,
    100
  )
)

print(ku_summary, row.names = FALSE)

# Overall KUF count, excluding UCT
kuf_overall_count <- df %>%
  filter(Site != "UCT") %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(assist_khat_amt %in% 0:5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(N)

cat(
  "\nOverall KUF sample size excluding UCT:",
  kuf_overall_count,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# assist_khat (Khat Use) distributions


assist_khat_labels <- c(`0` = "Never Used", `1` = "Has Used")
blue_life <- c("#c6dbef", "#08306b")  # light -> dark

df_life <- df %>%
  mutate(
    assist_khat = factor(assist_khat, levels = c(0, 1), labels = assist_khat_labels)
  ) %>%
  count(Site, assist_khat) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    pct = n / total,
    pct_lab = percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Build a 2-row-per-site label dataframe with explicit y positions
labels_life <- df_life %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total = dplyr::first(total),
    has_n = n[assist_khat == "Has Used"],
    never_n = n[assist_khat == "Never Used"],
    has_lab = pct_lab[assist_khat == "Has Used"],
    never_lab = pct_lab[assist_khat == "Never Used"],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

labels_has <- labels_life %>%
  transmute(
    Site,
    y = has_n,                 # top of Has Used segment (boundary)
    label = has_lab,
    vjust = -0.3                
  )

labels_never <- labels_life %>%
  transmute(
    Site,
    y = total,                 # top of full stack
    label = never_lab,
    vjust = -0.3               
  )

labels_plot <- bind_rows(labels_has, labels_never)

p1 <- ggplot(df_life, aes(x = Site, y = n, fill = assist_khat)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    data = labels_plot,
    aes(x = Site, y = y, label = label, vjust = vjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = blue_life) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Lifetime Khat Use",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Lifetime Usage"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(df_life$total) * 1.1)

print(p1)
```

```{r}
# assist_khat_amt (Khat Use Frequency) distribution

assist_khat_amt_labels <- c(
  `0` = "Never Used Lifetime",
  `1` = "Have Not Used",
  `2` = "Once or Twice",
  `3` = "Monthly",
  `4` = "Weekly",
  `5` = "Daily or Almost Daily"
)

df_freq <- df %>%
  mutate(assist_khat_amt = factor(
    assist_khat_amt,
    levels = 0:5,
    labels = assist_khat_amt_labels
  )) %>%
  count(Site, assist_khat_amt)

blue_freq <- c(
  "#deebf7",
  "#c6dbef",
  "#9ecae1",
  "#6baed6",
  "#3182bd",
  "#08519c"
)

p2 <- ggplot(df_freq,
             aes(x = Site, y = n, fill = assist_khat_amt)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = blue_freq) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Khat Use Frequency",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Usage Past 3 Months"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p2)
```

```{r}
# reported sample size that went into GWAS

null_model_dir <- "~/work/khat_gwas/debug/samples"

null_files <- list.files(
  path = null_model_dir,
  pattern = "^gp08_.*_assist_khat_saige_null\\.rda$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(null_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No assist_khat SAIGE null-model files found in: ",
    null_model_dir
  )
}

site_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(null_files, function(file) {
  
  # Load the .rda without placing its objects in the global environment
  model_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded_objects <- load(file, envir = model_env)
  
  # Identify the loaded object containing the phenotype vector y
  model_candidates <- loaded_objects[
    vapply(
      loaded_objects,
      function(object_name) {
        object <- model_env[[object_name]]
        is.list(object) && "y" %in% names(object)
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  
  if (length(model_candidates) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No model object containing a top-level `y` field found in ",
      basename(file)
    )
    
    return(
      tibble(
        Site = sub(
          "^gp08_(.*)_assist_khat_saige_null\\.rda$",
          "\\1",
          basename(file)
        ),
        Controls = NA_integer_,
        Cases = NA_integer_,
        Sample_size = NA_integer_
      )
    )
  }
  
  model <- model_env[[model_candidates[1]]]
  phenotype <- as.numeric(model$y)
  
  # Confirm that this is a binary 0/1 phenotype
  unexpected_values <- setdiff(
    unique(phenotype[!is.na(phenotype)]),
    c(0, 1)
  )
  
  if (length(unexpected_values) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Unexpected phenotype coding in ",
      basename(file),
      ": ",
      paste(unexpected_values, collapse = ", "),
      ". Expected 0 = control and 1 = case."
    )
  }
  
  controls <- sum(phenotype == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  cases    <- sum(phenotype == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_size <- controls + cases
  
  tibble(
    Site = sub(
      "^gp08_(.*)_assist_khat_saige_null\\.rda$",
      "\\1",
      basename(file)
    ),
    Controls = controls,
    Cases = cases,
    Sample_size = sample_size
  )
})

# Calculate proportions for each site
site_summary <- site_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Control_proportion = Controls / Sample_size,
    Case_proportion = Cases / Sample_size
  )

# Sum cases, controls, and sample sizes across all sites
overall_summary <- site_summary %>%
  summarise(
    Site = "Overall",
    Controls = sum(Controls, na.rm = TRUE),
    Cases = sum(Cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sample_size = sum(Sample_size, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Control_proportion = Controls / Sample_size,
    Case_proportion = Cases / Sample_size
  )

# Add the overall row to the site-level results
null_model_summary <- bind_rows(
  site_summary,
  overall_summary
) %>%
  mutate(
    `Control proportion` = scales::percent(
      Control_proportion,
      accuracy = 0.01
    ),
    `Case proportion` = scales::percent(
      Case_proportion,
      accuracy = 0.01
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Site,
    Controls,
    Cases,
    `Sample size` = Sample_size,
    `Control proportion`,
    `Case proportion`
  )

# Render a viewable table in the knitted document
knitr::kable(
  null_model_summary,
  caption = paste(
    "Samples included in the assist_khat SAIGE null models.",
    "The Overall row is calculated across all sites."
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
)
```
